notes: Current Jobs source compiled using the repository test build and its locked pgclear dependency. Each invocation runs both existing load profiles.
Two runners share one Node process, with two competing application loops. No other benchmark or test runs concurrently.
Each profile starts with 1500 bulk jobs and retained/expired history. Throughput includes that initial backlog and drain, not just producer time.
startDelayMs includes enqueue, intentional scheduling delay and retries where applicable; quiet queue kind 1 does not retry.
The slow-SQL profile changes both pool capacity and simulated SQL waits. It is not a controlled pool-size-only experiment.
Stress repeats three times; the lower-offer-rate run is a single diagnostic. Summary percentiles are medians of per-run percentiles, not pooled distributions.
Each run asserts all submitted jobs complete, each intended retry runs exactly twice, and no attempts expire or jobs fail. EXPLAIN timings are single observations.
